_description: Merge this 'hooks' block into your project's .claude/settings.json. These are real Claude Code hooks that fire during Claude sessions. They are the in-session counterpart to the git hooks (which fire outside Claude).

_notes.PostToolUse: Fires after every Edit/Write/MultiEdit. detect_changes.py determines which docs are affected by the edit and stores them for the Stop hook to surface.
_notes.Stop: Fires when Claude finishes a turn. Surfaces any docs that should be updated based on edits made during this session.
_notes.UserPromptSubmit: When the user's message contains doc-related keywords, run a quick audit before Claude responds — so Claude has fresh stale-doc context.
_notes.manual_invocation: You can always tell Claude directly: 'Check .claude/hooks/hooks.md and update the docs for this change.'
